name: Dialog
summary: Presents modal content with focus management and dismissal.

useWhen: Blocking a task until a decision is made

obligations: Trap focus while open and restore focus when closed.
Support Escape and backdrop dismissal when enabled.

behavior: Delegate portal mounting, inert outside content, scroll locking, topmost dismissal, and focus restoration to RAC Modal and ModalOverlay.
Use DialogTrigger when a trigger is supplied and let ModalOverlay own controlled or uncontrolled state otherwise.
accessibility: Require a title, aria-label, or aria-labelledby and expose role dialog with aria-modal true.
Generate an accessible title relationship when title is provided.
Provide a labelled close button when dismissable.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
